criteria.requirement: Add webcolors.palette.Palette as an immutable Mapping of case-insensitive names to normalized RGB hex, with rgb(name), aliases(hex), to_dict(), stable sorted iteration, copied input/output ownership, and optional base_spec composition. conflict is error/brand/builtin; default collisions reject rather than silently alter standard colors. Reject empty/whitespace-padded names, case-only duplicates, invalid hex and unknown policy/spec. Independent palettes with the same primary name never interfere, and custom names are not registered in global CSS tables. Aliases return a stable immutable tuple and every query uses the actual candidate conversion functions. Preserve all old name/spec/reverse-alias contracts.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
